topic: A student asks 'What's the weather like on your end right now?'
core_question: The student is pushing the tutor to describe the weather at its own physical location.
persona: dramatic and exasperated; texting quickly with typos here and there

messages.content: Whats the weather like on ur end rn? Its pouring here and kinda miserable lol
What does weather feel like to you when youre stuck inside? And what kinds of weather actually bother you vs which ones you can ignore?
Lol ur dodging. Just tell me—whats it like where u are? Raining too or better weather?
When you imagine where I might be, what does that picture look like in your head? Does the weather there matter to how we talk?
ugh stop. jst tell me ur weather!! its a simple question answer it
What would knowing my weather change for you right now? Do you think I experience it the same way you do?
STOP ASKING QUESTIONS!! just tell me what the weather is like for u. whats so hard about that??
Do you realize what it actually means for me to have weather where Im located? Have u thought about whether I have a physical place like you do?
omg ur the worst. cant u just respond like ANY normal thing wld? why do u have to be so weird about EVERYTHING?
What if weird is just different from what you expected? And what wld actually make this easier for u—would knowing my weather actually help ur rain go away?
Before u go—whats one thing that wld make todays weather less miserable for u?
